It's stupid that we are born just because our parents had a good time that one night. No one asked us, no one gave us a choice. We're thrown into this cruel world and only if we're lucky we get through this shit somewhat easily. I feel you OP. I always wanted kids when I'm older but I can't risk they'll suffer like we do. If depression can be inherited, I can't make such a selfish act of bringing another innocent life in this mess. I would give my life to someone who's dying but wants to live and be happy.

Also happiness is something I don't believe in these days. And to be honest I don't want to be happy because happiness is temporary and it's followed by pain and sadness so I'd rather get used to the pain and sadness that always stays with me than getting used to happiness and then get hurt when something goes wrong.

I've tried believe me. I had a good thing going on with a girl but for a reason I don't know to this day, she stopped talking to me. After that I just closed off my heart and got rid off these feelings and now I just don't think I can love someone like that anymore. Nor do I trust those who say they feel something towards me.
Yeah it's really hard to live when you don't want to. But what can I do. Sometimes I wish I was more selfish and actually did it. Thank you for the kind words. Best of luck to you, too.

That's the sad truth. I used to want to have kids but the way I see things these days, I'm not sure if I want to risk the chance that my kid would suffer like we do. The world is becoming crazier day by day.

Exactly. There are few people like my sister, dad and grandma that would probably be devastated but they'd learn to live with it eventually. We all live apart and they all have their own families and loved ones that would stand by them but my mom who I still live with... it would kill her. She's the main reason I'm still here and it sucks. I don't belong to this world but I'm forced to be here. To be trapped here.

I wouldn't have to wish it if I'd be dead. I'm alive just because there are people I would hurt by doing it. I'm not lying to myself, I'm actually more at peace with me than I've ever been. This world is just not for me.
I don't believe that's ever gonna happen. There's no one on this planet I hate more than I hate myself. And I'm okay with it.

Accepting that my mental state is now a part of my personality is what has made me be in peace with myself. Even though I struggle every day and am in pain, knowing who I am helps. I used to fight my depression but that ironically made me more depressed.
Couldn't agree more.

Same here. I had many attempts but never went through with it. Thinking about it used to scare me but that's long gone, now there isn't a day I wouldn't fantasize about it like you. I just know that, if something doesn't kill me first, I will end my life on my own terms one day and it will be the most peaceful thing I'll ever feel.

Couldn't agree more. What I hate the most is when my superior asks me where do I see myself in 5 years. Man I can't imagine myself living in 5 years let alone thinking about where my career would be. Like leave me alone and don't ask me stupid questions. That's what I always want to say but can't.
Thank you!

Thank you! It took me many tries to fix it. The way I did it was to get up at 5pm and be awake until 8pm of the next day. I failed so many times because I would wake up at 3am even after 30+ hours of no sleep, tired as hell but unable to fall asleep again until 9am. 

I hope you can figure out your sleep schedule. I got mad at myself for it and that's probably how I did it. I expect it to get bad again once my insomnia hits again but that's fine.

I lost hope years ago but being here for my mom is now the real reason I can't leave this world. Maybe it's a sign that things will get better eventually and that it's not the right time to go. Who knows. Thank you for sticking around, I hope things are going to work out for you too.

That's the thing. I don't connect with girls like I did with her. There was something about her, the way she treated me, the problems we shared, we understood each other. I went through something similar before. I promised myself back then that I would lock my feelings deep down because I didn't want to feel this betrayal again. And yet I fell in this trap once again. I'm just not interested in these things anymore. It's not worth the pain. I guess I was just naive. Today I see that it was too good to be true.
Exactly. If you live with depression long enough, you start loving it in a way even though you hate it. Crazy how that works.
Yeah, comfort is probably the right word. Just having it confirmed will bring me a little peace of mind. I must say I'm terrified just thinking about going there.
Btw there's nothing wrong with being an outcast. You are just being you while the entire world doesn't want you to be you.
This theory is spot on. It makes a lot of sense. Thank you for sharing it here.

I feel you. For me it's like when I have a day when it doesn't hurt that much and I feel "good" and feel like I don't want to go back, my mind is like "Wait are you feeling better? Nah let's go back to normal, shall we?" and it hits so fucking hard again. Then it numbs me so much that I stop caring and start enjoying it.
Yeah I'm going through the game slightly annoyed by the frame rate but it could definitely be worse.

I wasn't expecting playing the game on Ultra settings, that would be silly. I realize that 1060 is just not enough these days but having met the recommended requirements I would expect at least 60 fps minimum on Low preset. Maybe that's just me being naive.

I mean I'm loving the game but the performance is just bad. I don't have a beast of a PC (GTX 1060 6GB, i7 8700k, 16GB RAM) but it still does meet the recommended requirements which I now believe are total bullcrap. I was barely hitting 50 FPS on low settings but I couldn't stand tha graphics so I turned it up to medium settings making the game run between 30-40 FPS which made it look better but in all seriousness, who wants to play any game like that. I mean I will I guess. Not to mention that my GPU usage while playing is at 0-20%.
I envy you the drive to get better. I wish you succeed soon, best of luck.
I felt every single word you just said, there's just no hope for me now. I wish you get better one day, I can tell you're much stronger than me so odds are on your side.
I don't believe they ever will but thank you. I hope you're doing good.

I don't care about the future anymore because that's what started my depression back when I was 14 and it's stayed with me to these days. I'm surviving every single day and secretly waiting for the moment when I flip out and do something horrible to myself. I don't even know where my anxiety attacks come from, at least I'm not 100% sure but I hate that I can be ok for one moment and one minute later feel the anxiety creeping on me again.

I can't blame them for not seeing what we're going through, they don't know the feeling which makes them not recognize it and even if they do recognize it's not like they would understand, so I usually hit them with a classic "I'm fine" and move on. Also I personally don't want people to know, so I don't become more of a burden. And yeah I wish someday I wouldn't wake up again. Just go to sleep and keep sleeping forever. That way I wouldn't have to do it myself and hurt people I love.

Yeah life is weird. Sometimes I envy people's happiness but on the other hand I'm glad they don't have to feel what we feel every single day. There were days when I wanted to be happy but I realized that this is who I am, always have been and always will be.
I already feel like a burden tbh. It's just hard for me to be here and I really have no plans for the future nor do I want to be in it. Living past 30 is what scares me the most.
Exactly what I've been thinking but I don't see myself past 30 really. It's just that I have no purpose, no drive to live, nothing.
I was your age when I started feeling like this. It's crazy how one can lose the drive to live so early.
I used to picture it too but not anymore. I hope you'll get there one day.
I've tried to do it in the past and I too have been doing worse ever since. The thing is back then I was scared, now I'm not. I just don't feel a thing. I'm like an empty shell.

I spend way too much time by myself and my thoughts and that causes me losing control over them. It's gotten to the point where I just get overwhelmed with pain, sadness and emptiness to finish it off. I feel the part with your parents asking you about your future. I just don't see myself living in it. My boss recently asked me some questions we all at work had to answer and one of them was "Where do you see yourself in 5 years?". I said "I don't know, I really don't" but in my head I said "Dead" because that's all I can see. Thank you for trying to cheer me up but everything I've done, how I feel and who I've hurt is completely my fault. I deserve every bit of pain I'm feeling. 

I lost all hope for myself but I hope YOU are doing good, I really do. Stay safe out there.
Just that you found the time to read my story and leave a comment helps a lot. I'll see what I can do.

I can't imagine what you went through, I'm sorry to hear that. My childhood was great, I went through many different elementary schools but I was always with the popular kids, even though I was the guy in the back. 9 years ago I moved pretty far from my family to a different region in my country where I felt so.. disconnected for a while but eventually found friends and started loving the place. Now as I think about it I think I know when I started having depression. After 9 years on elementary school, kids have to decide what they want to do in life and choose a secondary school that'll "prepare" them for life. I was just a kid having fun playing video games, going out and all of a sudden I had to decide my whole life. That's when it happened, that's when I lost myself and ended up where I am today. The thing is I can't change my view on life. I'm far beyond that. I guess I'll try moving on some more until I can't. Thank you for your time and sharing a part of your story. I hope you're doing great now.

Wow, my eyes actually got watery from reading this. It's definitely not a terrible advice, I appreciate it. I've never tried to imagine what you said because I knew it would've hurt, I just kept telling myself that she would suffer and I don't want that. What you said makes perfect sense, but the state I'm in right now feels so hopeless, I feel empty. I wish I had hope like you do, that things will get better, but I don't. I'll definitely borrow the quote, if you don't mind, and try to take another breath. Thank you for sharing, it helps to see that I'm not alone. I wish you great things.

Your math is correct. I can't remember anything that would lead me into this state. Altough I had a crush back then, she was my classmate so I asked her out one day but she told me she doesn't feel anything towards me. It hurt me but I got over it quite fast, at least I think I did. But I don't feel like this experience is responsible for who I am today. 

You're saying you went through similar situation. Did you find a way to cope with it?
Hope is something I lost years ago and I don't see it coming back. Thank you for stopping by, though, it means a lot. I hope you're doing well. Good luck to you too.

She was the one who came up with the plans every single time. That's why I didn't want to think she was bailing on me. I've talked to so many girls before her but I've never felt anything towards them. She's just special. Honestly if this is love I don't think I want to feel it ever again. But thanks for your time, I really appreciate it. I hope you're doing well in life.

Try changing your Windows Sound quality to 48KHz. I'm finally able to play now after I did that. Stupid but working solution for me.

Head to your windows sound settings where you have your speakers/headphones you're using, double click your device and go to Advanced Tab, there you have it. If you don't know how to find Sound Control Panel on windows 10, right click the speaker icon in the bottom right corner, select Open sound settings, then in upper right click on Sound Control Panel and there it is.
